copy.curiosityHook: As postwar optimism sweeps Yokohama, what forgotten truth from Umi and Shun's origins stands between them?
copy.description: In 1963 Yokohama, high school students Umi and Shun form a close bond amid Japan's postwar renewal, only for a buried secret from their shared past to threaten their blossoming connection.
copy.vibeSummary: Thoughtful, emotional, and moderately paced, balancing tender teen drama with postwar historical reflection.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Goro Miyazaki, this tender period drama captures the bittersweet optimism of a nation in flux through an evocative and deeply felt high school bond.

allowedMaterial: Setting in 1963 Yokohama during postwar recovery ahead of the 1964 Olympics
High school students Umi and Shun developing a close bond
Initial conflict of a buried secret from their past threatening to pull them apart
Director Goro Miyazaki and animation period drama genres
excludedMaterial: Resolution of Umi and Shun's relationship
Clubhouse preservation outcome and third-act developments
